SELECT VENDOR.VENDOR_NAME,
  SUM(INVOICE_HEADER.INVOICE_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_INVOICE_AMOUNT
FROM INVOICE_HEADER
INNER JOIN VENDOR ON INVOICE_HEADER.VENDOR_ID = VENDOR.VENDOR_ID
WHERE INVOICE_HEADER.STATUS = 'A'
  AND INVOICE_HEADER.INVOICE_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
GROUP BY VENDOR.VENDOR_NAME
ORDER BY SUM(INVOICE_HEADER.INVOICE_AMOUNT) DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;
